title: Yiwu Sourcing Agent
short: Small commodities, gifts and daily goods from the famous Yiwu wholesale market.
intro: Yiwu in Zhejiang province is known for its huge wholesale market for small commodities. Global Grabz helps you search the market, compare many suppliers in a short time, and combine small purchases into one shipment.
points: Market visits and supplier comparison
Low MOQ buying from many suppliers
Consolidation into one shipment
Sample collection and checking

faq.q: What can I buy in Yiwu?
faq.a: Yiwu is best for small commodities such as accessories, toys, stationery, gifts and household items.

faq.q: Can I buy small quantities?
faq.a: Many Yiwu suppliers accept low MOQs. We combine your purchases and ship them together.

title: Shenzhen Sourcing Agent
short: Electronics, gadgets and hardware from Shenzhen, the technology hub of China.
intro: Shenzhen in Guangdong province is a centre for electronics manufacturing and product development. We connect you with factories for consumer electronics, accessories and smart devices, and manage samples and quality checks.
points: Factory matching for OEM electronics
Component and sample testing
Certification document requests such as CE, FCC and RoHS
Special handling for battery and electronic cargo

faq.q: Do you handle electronics with batteries?
faq.a: Yes, but battery cargo has special shipping rules. We choose a suitable carrier and route and prepare the required documents.

faq.q: Can Shenzhen factories make custom electronics?
faq.a: Many can. We find factories with OEM and ODM experience and manage samples and approvals.

title: Guangzhou Sourcing Agent
short: Apparel, bags, shoes, beauty and furniture from the Canton Fair city.
intro: Guangzhou is a major trade city and home of the Canton Fair. It is strong in apparel, bags, shoes, cosmetics, lighting and furniture. We visit markets and factories for you and handle inspection and export.
points: Wholesale market and factory visits
Canton Fair support and supplier follow up
Quality inspection before shipment
Export through Guangzhou and nearby ports

faq.q: Can you help me with the Canton Fair?
faq.a: Yes. We can visit the fair for you, collect catalogs and quotes, and follow up with the exhibitors you shortlist.

faq.q: Which products are strongest in Guangzhou?
faq.a: Apparel, bags, shoes, beauty products, lighting and furniture are strong categories.

title: Shanghai Sourcing Agent
short: Higher value manufacturing and one of the largest container ports in the world.
intro: Shanghai and the Yangtze River Delta have advanced factories and one of the largest container ports in the world. We source higher value products here and ship by sea and air through Shanghai.
points: Factory audits for higher value orders
Shipping through Shanghai Pudong airport and Yangshan port
Quality control for precision products
FCL and LCL sea freight support

faq.q: Why source from Shanghai?
faq.a: The region has strong manufacturers, good infrastructure and direct air and sea routes to every major market.

faq.q: Do you ship through Shanghai port?
faq.a: Yes. We can ship FCL and LCL sea freight and air freight through Shanghai gateways.

title: Hong Kong Sourcing Agent
short: Sourcing, trade fairs, consolidation and air freight through the Hong Kong free port.
intro: Hong Kong is a free port and one of the busiest air cargo hubs in the world. Global Grabz sources products from Hong Kong suppliers and trading companies, attends trade fairs for you, and consolidates goods from Hong Kong and mainland China into one international shipment.
points: Supplier search and verification in Hong Kong
Trade fair visits and supplier follow up
Air freight through Hong Kong International Airport
Consolidation of Hong Kong and mainland China goods
Support for re-export and transshipment cargo

faq.q: Can you source products from Hong Kong?
faq.a: Yes. We work with suppliers and trading companies in Hong Kong and can combine their goods with products from mainland China.

faq.q: Can you ship goods out through Hong Kong?
faq.a: Yes. We can arrange air and sea freight through Hong Kong gateways when it suits your route, cost and delivery time.

title: Dongguan Sourcing Agent
short: Electronics, furniture, shoes and toys from a major manufacturing city in Guangdong.
intro: Dongguan sits between Shenzhen and Guangzhou and has a dense network of factories. It is known for electronics assembly, furniture, footwear, garments and toys. We find the right factory, manage samples and inspect production before shipment.
points: Direct factory sourcing and price negotiation
OEM and private label manufacturing support
Factory audit and quality inspection
Easy consolidation with Shenzhen and Guangzhou orders

faq.q: What is Dongguan best for?
faq.a: Dongguan is strong in electronics, furniture, footwear, garments and toys, with many factories that accept OEM orders.

faq.q: Can you combine Dongguan goods with Shenzhen orders?
faq.a: Yes. The cities are close, so we can consolidate goods from both into one shipment.

title: Foshan Sourcing Agent
short: Furniture, ceramics, lighting and home appliances from Guangdong.
intro: Foshan is a large manufacturing base in Guangdong known for furniture, ceramic tiles, lighting, aluminium products and home appliances. We visit showrooms and factories for you, compare quotes and manage inspection and shipping.
points: Factory and showroom visits
Packaging checks for heavy and fragile goods
Quality inspection before shipment
Sea freight FCL and LCL for bulky cargo

faq.q: Can you source furniture in Foshan?
faq.a: Yes. We visit furniture factories, compare quotes, check finish and packaging, and arrange shipping for bulky orders.

faq.q: How are fragile goods like tiles shipped?
faq.a: We check packaging at the factory and recommend strong cartons or pallets to reduce breakage during sea freight.

title: Ningbo Sourcing Agent
short: Small appliances, hardware, auto parts and molds near a top container port.
intro: Ningbo in Zhejiang province has strong manufacturing in small appliances, hardware, auto parts, plastics and molds, and it is next to one of the largest container ports in the world. We source, inspect and ship through Ningbo for buyers worldwide.
points: Factory sourcing and supplier checks
Sea freight through Ningbo port
Quality control for industrial goods
Consolidation with Shanghai and Yiwu orders

faq.q: Why source from Ningbo?
faq.a: Ningbo has many factories for appliances, hardware and auto parts, and a major port that keeps sea freight simple.

faq.q: Can you combine Ningbo goods with Yiwu or Shanghai orders?
faq.a: Yes. We can consolidate goods from nearby cities into one shipment.

title: Hangzhou Sourcing Agent
short: Textiles, silk, e-commerce products and fashion from the Yangtze River Delta.
intro: Hangzhou is a centre of online commerce and has strong textile, silk and apparel industries in the surrounding region. We help e-commerce sellers and fashion brands find suppliers, check samples and ship orders.
points: Supplier search for online sellers
Fabric and sample checks
Quality inspection before shipment
Small batch and fast turnaround options

faq.q: What can I source in Hangzhou?
faq.a: Textiles, silk, apparel and many products popular with online sellers.

faq.q: Do you support small online brands?
faq.a: Yes. We help small brands with low MOQ suppliers, samples and consolidated shipping.

title: Shantou Sourcing Agent
short: Toys, underwear, textiles and plastic goods from Chenghai and Shantou.
intro: Shantou in eastern Guangdong, especially the Chenghai district, is known for toys and for knitwear, underwear and textile production. We connect you with toy and textile factories, check safety documents and manage shipping.
points: Toy factory search and sample checks
Safety test report requests such as EN71 and ASTM
Quality inspection before shipment
Shipping through Shenzhen and Guangzhou ports

faq.q: Can you source toys from Shantou?
faq.a: Yes. We find toy factories, request test reports and check samples before you order.

faq.q: Do toys need safety certificates?
faq.a: Most markets require toy safety testing. We ask factories for test reports, and you should confirm the rules for your country.

title: Qingdao Sourcing Agent

intro: Qingdao in Shandong province is a major port city with strong manufacturing in machinery, home appliances, tyres and rubber products. We source industrial products here and ship through Qingdao port.
points: Factory audits for machinery and equipment
Pre-shipment inspection for heavy goods
Sea freight through Qingdao port
Export documents for industrial cargo

faq.q: Do you handle heavy machinery?
faq.a: Yes. We check the factory, inspect the machine before shipment and arrange suitable sea freight.

faq.q: Can you ship through Qingdao port?
faq.a: Yes. We can arrange FCL and LCL sea freight through Qingdao.
